scope: Bounded source provider/consumer contract review only

dependencies.contract: S validates direction and range; derives opposite direction through chronology, copies opposite sequence into mutable list of original elements, stores optional callback, shares chronology and calls OA75 after range initialization. Main-index wrapper passes no clamp; confirmation wrapper passes direction/reaction using provider default intrabar start. _detect clears ownership and audit, audits each A, then calls OA76 before next-A confirmation exclusion; passes result to candidate resolver. No OA77 reset is shown in _detect; repeated invocations on the same instance retain native cache unless reinitialized.
dependencies.boundary: Local delegation and observed callsites only; do not infer global input immutability or candidate acceptance.

dependencies.contract: reaction_identity reads First then Break, int-normalizes both; no direction, time, price or ordinal component.
dependencies.boundary: Physical normalized pair equality is not full object or chronology equivalence.

dependencies.contract: Main mapping bisect_right(times,timestamp)-1, pre-first raises unless clamp, default False. Confirmation cache uses provider key and exact intrabar start default; normalizes direction-dependent level and scans strict lower crossing in break candle, falls back to break candle start if absent. Standalone bounded callback accepts gate/stop/end but local cache keys gate/end, uses bounded directional search. Continuous provider limits end and guards gate, keys by direction/gate/limit/event; copies cached candidate on hit.
dependencies.boundary: OA76 does not verify provider geometry, remapped chronology or cache consistency; local source-level provider boundaries only. No equivalence between callback paths asserted.

dependencies.contract: S receives opposite native reactions and direction-specific initial_order_geometry. Reusable context binds opposite direction in lambda; forwards gate_index,end_index,gate_event to geometry detector; when live non-None invokes live.order_geometry(detector,order_direction,gate_index,end_index,gate_event). Standalone path uses directional_a_stop_order_finder. S result consumption can reuse full state or construct S for non-reusable path.
dependencies.boundary: Dynamic live receiver implementation not inferred; forwarding order verified, no new W2/W3 cross-owner acceptance.

dependencies.contract: OA75–OA77 own initial native index, native-only exact-stop cache and independent-vs-native selection; callback may return nested geometry without inventing public Reaction number. No stop calculation, ledger registration, acceptance or crossing performed in these methods.
dependencies.boundary: Later OA78+ and Lifecycle/Bridge consumers remain outside this checkpoint.

limitations: Separate source-first local review by GPT, not independently staffed. No runtime, RAW, ZIP, new cross-owner acceptance or production change.

The native lookup depends on stable comparable timestamps, stable normalized indices, tuple/list alignment and stable owner state; mutability, aliasing and custom attribute/call semantics are not ruled out. No assertion that malformed input occurs.
OA76 remapped confirmation is not re-gated; the native winner ranks by confirmation first, the combined selection ranks by First first. No runtime equivalence or defect assertion.
Live Bridge invocation is a dynamic provider boundary; the presence or implementation of an arbitrary live object is not established by the callsite alone. No new cross-owner acceptance.
Existing canonical AST inventories compared directly, not freshly generated; no independent SHA-256 assertion.
